model: PE-Core-B-16 image vector (L2-normalized, open_clip squash-224) + SCRFD face boxes
trained_on: Wikimedia Commons iPhone photos, EXIF front/back label, N=17594, pos=3028
geo_design: sqrt(area_frac), centre_off, centre_y, log1p(n_faces), second_ratio, has_face
score: logit = w . ((x - mean) / std) + b ; selfie if logit >= threshold

geo_lr.note: thresholds = from out-of-fold scores at Commons prevalence; re-pick on the phone's tagged set

vec_lr.note: thresholds = from out-of-fold scores at Commons prevalence; re-pick on the phone's tagged set
vec_lr.folded_note: score = dot(w_folded, x_raw) + b_folded, x_raw = the L2-normalized PE-Core-B-16 vector (as stored); identical to the standardized form

recommended.why: see report.txt; re-pick on the phone tagged set

combo_lr.note: thresholds = from out-of-fold scores at Commons prevalence; re-pick on the phone's tagged set
combo_lr.folded_note: score = dot(w_folded, x_raw) + b_folded, x_raw = the L2-normalized PE-Core-B-16 vector (as stored); identical to the standardized form

geo_rule.feature: largest face area / frame area (SCRFD box)
